sections.description_of_the_main_ingredients:
T riphala: This is prepared by mixing equal parts of Amalaki ( Emblica officinalis ), Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ), Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellerica ). It is a wonderful combination with various health benefits. This pacifies all the three Doshas and possesses antioxidant, immune modulating, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic and analgesic property. We can use this as a Rasayan (rejuvenative) because it nourishes the body and strengthen its normal functioning. 
 Trikatu: This is obtained by mixing Shunthi ( Zingiber officinalis ), Pippali ( Piper longum ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ). It is very effective in kapha elevated disorders as it pacifies kapha Dosha. It also stimulates the digestive juices and alleviates the toxins from the body. 
 Vacha: Scientifically it is known as Acorus calamus. This acts as an appetizer due to its deepana (increases digestive fire) and pachana (digestive properties) properties. It is also indicated in various neurological and psychological disorders. 
 Shuddha Hingula: Botanically it is known as Ferula assa-foetida. This pacifies vata and kapha dosha. It increases pitta dosha and relieves abdominal pain. This stimulates digestive fire and is used as an appetizer. 
 Datura ( Datura metel ): This stimulates digestive fire and is used as an appetizer. It pacifies kapha Dosha and used in numerous upper Respiratory tract disorders. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the above dravya (things) in equal quantity. 
 Make a fine powder. After then apply bhavna of goat’s urine to the latter 
 Make tablets and let it dry. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 This anjana is best for anxiety and depression patients. Dhatura is useful in brain problems. It pacifies kapha dosha. Triphala and trikatu are best for digestion. They improve digestive power by stimulating digestive fire. Vacha acts as an appetizer and increases appetite. Anjana prachetna vati is helpful in treating anxiety attacks by pacifying kapha dosha. It is effective in fever and eye problems.

Anjana Prachetna Vati 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Jwaradhikar 114/306-307 
 Introduction 
 This is an Ayurvedic classical herbal composition. It is effective in fever, headache, eye problems etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Pipali ( Piper longum ) 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) 
 Datura Seeds ( Datura metel ) 
 Amla ( Emblica officinalis ) 
 Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ) 
 Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellirica ) 
 Sunthi ( Zingiber officinale ) 
 Shudh hingu ( Ferula assafoetida ) 
 Sindhav lavan ( Rock salt ) 
 Sarson ( Mustard ) 
 
 Description of the Main Ingredients 
 
 T riphala: This is prepared by mixing equal parts of Amalaki ( Emblica officinalis ), Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ), Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellerica ). It is a wonderful combination with various health benefits. This pacifies all the three Doshas and possesses antioxidant, immune modulating, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic and analgesic property. We can use this as a Rasayan (rejuvenative) because it nourishes the body and strengthen its normal functioning. 
 Trikatu: This is obtained by mixing Shunthi ( Zingiber officinalis ), Pippali ( Piper longum ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ). It is very effective in kapha elevated disorders as it pacifies kapha Dosha. It also stimulates the digestive juices and alleviates the toxins from the body. 
 Vacha: Scientifically it is known as Acorus calamus. This acts as an appetizer due to its deepana (increases digestive fire) and pachana (digestive properties) properties. It is also indicated in various neurological and psychological disorders. 
 Shuddha Hingula: Botanically it is known as Ferula assa-foetida. This pacifies vata and kapha dosha. It increases pitta dosha and relieves abdominal pain. This stimulates digestive fire and is used as an appetizer. 
 Datura ( Datura metel ): This stimulates digestive fire and is used as an appetizer. It pacifies kapha Dosha and used in numerous upper Respiratory tract disorders. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the above dravya (things) in equal quantity. 
 Make a fine powder. After then apply bhavna of goat’s urine to the latter 
 Make tablets and let it dry. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 This anjana is best for anxiety and depression patients. Dhatura is useful in brain problems. It pacifies kapha dosha. Triphala and trikatu are best for digestion. They improve digestive power by stimulating digestive fire. Vacha acts as an appetizer and increases appetite. Anjana prachetna vati is helpful in treating anxiety attacks by pacifying kapha dosha. It is effective in fever and eye problems. 
 Indications 
 
 Effective in anxiety 
 Depression 
 Stress 
 Eye problems 
 Headache 
 
 How To Apply 
 Apply this Anjana over eyes twice daily. 
 Cautions 
 Apply under medical supervision.
